MRI Safety Information
The Umbra Neuromodulation System is MR Conditional. A person with the Umbra Neuromodulation System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Umbra Neuromodulation System
Device Configuration MRI SureScan mode
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5T and 3T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 3,000 gauss/cm (30 T/m)
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions For 1.5T MR Scanner: B1+rms must not exceed 3.2 μT; when B1+rms is not displayed, use a whole body SAR of 1 W/kg or less
For 3T MR Scanner: B1+rms <= 1 uT; Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.1 W/kg
Scan Duration at 3T: No more than 10 minutes of active scan time per session.
